$comment: Allows only flags that narrow or sort ripgrep's default project file list; omitting flags runs rg --files with inherited ripgrep config disabled.
title: Forge rg files tool input

flags.description: Optional ripgrep flags in CLI order. Supported: exclusion --glob=!PATTERN or --iglob=!PATTERN, --max-depth=N, --type=TYPE, --type-not=TYPE, --sort=path. Flags that include hidden or ignored files are rejected. Use [] for the default rg --files listing.
